sourceText: The doctor shuddered. “They were crying it in the square,” he said. “I heard them in my dining-room.”

attempts.label: primary
attempts.visibleOutput:
TRANSLATION: jan pi sona sijelo li tawa lili tan pilin monsuta. ona li toki e ni: “jan mute li kalama suli e ni lon ma open. mi kute e ona lon tomo moku mi.”
